configurations.name: Dashwheel → tablet CP20 (install + launch)
runtimeArgs: .\gradlew.bat :app:installGithubDebug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { adb -s ZCSI4IK2RP shell am start -n com.mydashwheel.dash/.MainActivity }

configurations.name: Dashwheel → device por defecto (install + launch)
runtimeArgs: .\gradlew.bat :app:installGithubDebug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { adb shell am start -n com.mydashwheel.dash/.MainActivity }

configurations.name: Dashwheel → solo abrir (sin rebuild)
runtimeArgs: adb -s ZCSI4IK2RP shell am start -n com.mydashwheel.dash/.MainActivity

configurations.name: Release → github (APK firmado, launcher + companion)
runtimeArgs: .\gradlew.bat :app:assembleGithubRelease :companion:assembleGithubRelease; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'APKs firmados:' -ForegroundColor Green; Get-ChildItem app\build\outputs\apk\github\release\*.apk, companion\build\outputs\apk\github\release\*.apk | Select-Object FullName, Length }

configurations.name: Release → play (AAB + APK firmados)
runtimeArgs: .\gradlew.bat :app:bundlePlayRelease :app:assemblePlayRelease :companion:bundlePlayRelease; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'AAB/APK firmados:' -ForegroundColor Green; Get-ChildItem app\build\outputs\bundle\playRelease\*.aab, app\build\outputs\apk\play\release\*.apk, companion\build\outputs\bundle\playRelease\*.aab | Select-Object FullName, Length }
